description: Session-token datasets created on both backends before running cases. ${SNAPSHOT} is replaced by the snapshot server URL. logTokens map session tokens found in the access logs (whose request bodies were recovered or approximated) to these datasets.

gtex-hubmap.description: GTEx portal EUI (log token recovered: ccf-api.hubmapconsortium.org gtex + hubmap rui_locations, host no longer resolves; approximated with current gtex + hubmap ds-graphs)

sennet.description: SenNet portal EUI (log token not recovered, likely includes an auth token)

inline.description: Inline JSON-LD data source (the GTEx snapshot embedded in the request body)

broken.description: A data source that does not exist; the dataset should end up in the Error state on both backends
